dock.title: AIMEE
dock.intro: Ask about what you are looking at. AIMEE reads AIMS for you; any change shows here as a card and waits for your OK.

suggest.showHowPrompt: Show me how to do this step
suggest.BL_DRAFT_APPROVAL_2: Does the B/L draft match the order?
suggest.SHIPPING_DOCS_1: Which shipping documents are still missing?
suggest.CUSTOMER_DOCS_1: Which customer documents do I make for this client?
suggest.SEND_DOCS_SCHEDULE_1: Draft the email that sends the documents
suggest.CI_PAYMENT_1: What is the CI amount, and which CI version is it from?
suggest.CUSTOMS_TAX_ESTIMATE_1: How is this import tax calculated?
suggest.CUSTOMS_TAX_ESTIMATE_2: Which invoice is the CIF from?
suggest.TAX_FUNDS_1: How much import tax do we need to fund?
suggest.TAX_FUNDS_2: Estimate vs permit: what is the difference?
suggest.AN_INSTRUCTIONS_1: Draft the 出庫・納入依頼書 for this shipment
suggest.IMPORT_PERMIT_1: Is the import permit filed, and what tax does it show?
suggest.INVOICE_2_1: What goes on the final invoice?
suggest.LOGISTICS_PAYMENT_1: Which transport and storage costs are still open?
suggest.email_2: What does this email ask for?
suggest.dash_3: Show me how to reopen a cancelled order
suggest.order_1: What is the status of this order?
suggest.order_2: Which documents are on this order?

bar.greeting: {greet}{hasName, select, yes {, {name}} other {}}. What shall we do?
bar.sub: Ask anything or say what you need. Drafts open on the side and wait for your OK.

chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · anything final asks you first
